text: Do you have any history of diabetes, hypertension, or multiple sclerosis, and have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your arms or legs? Have you experienced any recent head injuries or infections?

text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, rigidity, tremor, and orthostatic hypotosis, I suspect a synucleinopathy like Multiple System Atrophy. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain and Spine.
